applies_to: ClimateMaster Tranquility Large Water-to-Water (TMW) modules, models 360-840, with the factory IO FLEX6126 + EX8160 controller.
summary: Each TMW module has its own factory controller (IO FLEX6126 with an EX8160 expander) that talks BACnet MS/TP, Modbus or N2 on the same port, chosen with DIP switches. The points list covers physical inputs and outputs, BAS enable commands for cooling and heating, leaving-water targets, compressor and valve status, setpoints and tuning values, and a long block of alarm BVs. One device per module.
default_device_instance: 2460xx (DEV:2460xx in the list; xx = module address)
notes: The Read Only column of the list is used for access. AV/BV points without the read-only mark are shown as writable; many of them are configuration and tuning values. Nine alarm and calculated points with no Modbus mapping (so the column is blank) are shown read-only.
Descriptions are the list's own labels; the bracketed tag is the list's Note column: Physical I/O, Key status, BAS command input, Alarm reset or Alarm.
The Value column of the list holds sample live readings, not defaults. Units are taken from it where shown, so many temperature points have no unit here.
Object names end in _1 as printed; the object type labels in the list (BAI, BAV, BBV, BALM, BMSV) map to AI, AV, BV, BV and MSV.
AI:24 is not in the list (the AI numbers jump from 23 to 25).

The BAS start-up sequence in the manual calls the valve and source-flow points mot_valve_status_1 and source_flow_1; in the points list they are mot_vlv_status_1 (BV 107, mot_vlv_status_1) and src_flow_1 (BV 73).

source.title: Tranquility Large Water-to-Water (TMW) Series Models 360-840 - Installation, Operation & Maintenance (BACnet, Modbus, N2 Points List)

integration.summary: Set the module's MS/TP address on the two rotary switches and the protocol and baud rate on the DIP switches. To run a module from the BAS, open the local enable inputs, write the leaving-water target (cool_temp_stp_1 or heat_temp_stp_1), turn the opposite mode's BAS enable off and the wanted one on, start the pumps once the motorized valves report open, and watch the flow and run status points.
integration.enable: The local digital enable inputs (dig_cool_enable_1 BI 4 and dig_heat_enable_1 BI 5) must be open. Then write cool_enable_bas_1 (BV 52) or heat_enable_bas_1 (BV 53) ON, with the other one OFF.
setup: Two rotary switches set the hardware address 02-99; it is read only at power-up and must be unique on the MS/TP segment.
DIP switches 1 and 2 set the baud rate (9600, 19.2k, 38.4k or 76.8k); DIP switches 5, 7 and 8 select MS/TP, N2 or Modbus.
The device ID is shown in the list as DEV:2460xx.
gotchas: The cool leaving-water target accepts 42-62 °F and the heat target 80-135 °F.
Start the load and source pumps only after the motorized valves report open (BV 107, mot_vlv_status_1); the module will not run until both flows are proven.
Most alarms need a reset at the controller or from the BAS (reset BVs); high pressure also needs the manual reset on the unit's high-pressure switch.
